purpose: Radiation context for the three frozen ML scenarios, sourced from NASA OLTARIS or equivalent approved references.
usage_rules: These values are PROVENANCE METADATA. They must not be used as model features.

Nothing in the BioNano-Sim simulation consumes dose, LET or fluence. The damage proxy is a structural side-chain truncation whose severity is a count of removed side chains, not a function of exposure. Two scenarios therefore produce byte-identical physics and differ only by this label.

Joining these values onto training rows as features would be harmful, not merely useless: within a scenario the value is constant (zero variance), and across scenarios the target does not respond, so a model would fit a spurious mapping from a constant-per-group label onto label noise and report misleading feature importance.

A dose value may only become a feature once a documented, citable dose -> side-chain-damage-yield relationship exists (dataset source 4, peer-reviewed literature). That mapping must be recorded in 'damage_coupling' below, with citations, before any scenario field is used in training.

Leave a field null until it is verified against a named reference. Do not substitute the demonstration presets in radiation_scenarios.json: those are marked CONFIGURABLE_DEMONSTRATION_PRESETS and are explicitly not NASA, ESA or ICRP values (see docs/scientific-scope.md).

damage_coupling.note: Until this is populated, severity is an arbitrary but well-defined structural axis (number of side chains removed) and carries no physical exposure meaning.

field_definitions.dose_gy: Absorbed dose in gray, for the stated mission duration.
field_definitions.let_kev_per_um: Linear energy transfer, keV per micrometre, in water.
field_definitions.fluence_particles_per_cm2: Integrated particle fluence for the stated duration.
field_definitions.shielding_g_per_cm2: Aluminium-equivalent shielding assumed by the reference.
field_definitions.mission_duration_days: Duration the dose and fluence figures correspond to.
field_definitions.source: Named reference, e.g. 'NASA OLTARIS' plus the run or table identifier.
field_definitions.citation: Full citation for a paper, or the OLTARIS run parameters.
field_definitions.verified: true only when a named person has checked the value against the source.

scenarios.label: Deep-space GCR reference
scenarios.notes: Galactic cosmic ray background in free space, outside any planetary magnetosphere.

scenarios.label: Solar particle event reference
scenarios.notes: Acute solar particle event. Dose is delivered over hours to days rather than continuously, so a dose rate is not interchangeable with the GCR figure.

scenarios.label: Mars surface reference
scenarios.notes: Mars surface, attenuated by atmosphere and with an approximate 2-pi geometry from the planet body. Not interchangeable with the free-space GCR figure.
